content.value_statement: Windows PowerShell scripts often fail because of syntax, path, encoding, and null handling issues. This skill gives concise patterns for safer, more predictable scripts.
actual_capabilities: Explains when PowerShell cmdlet calls need parentheses with logical operators.
Recommends ASCII-safe output markers for Windows PowerShell scripts.
Shows null checks before reading object, array, or string properties.
Documents safer string interpolation, path joining, array, and JSON patterns.
Provides a basic script template with strict mode, try/catch, and exit codes.
limitations: It does not execute, test, or debug scripts by itself.
It focuses on Windows PowerShell patterns, not every PowerShell 7 feature.
Examples are brief and may need adaptation for complex automation.
It does not provide full security hardening for privileged scripts.

use_cases.title: Review Windows Automation Scripts
use_cases.description: Check scripts for common syntax traps, null access, path handling, and JSON depth mistakes before use.

use_cases.title: Write Safer PowerShell Examples
use_cases.description: Use concise patterns when creating documentation, runbooks, or support notes for PowerShell users.

use_cases.title: Guide Agent-Generated Scripts
use_cases.description: Ask an AI coding assistant to follow Windows PowerShell rules while drafting or revising automation.
use_cases.target_user: Developers using Claude, Codex, or Claude Code

prompt_templates.title: Check Basic Syntax
prompt_templates.scenario: Beginner review for a short script.
prompt_templates.prompt: Review my Windows PowerShell script for syntax issues, missing parentheses, Unicode output, and unsafe null access.

prompt_templates.title: Improve Reliability
prompt_templates.scenario: Intermediate cleanup before sharing a script.
prompt_templates.prompt: Rewrite this PowerShell script using the skill patterns for paths, arrays, JSON depth, string interpolation, and error handling.

prompt_templates.title: Create a Script Template
prompt_templates.prompt: Create a Windows PowerShell script outline for this task. Include strict mode, clear paths, try/catch handling, and ASCII-safe output.

prompt_templates.title: Audit an Automation Runbook
prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced review across a documented workflow.
prompt_templates.prompt: Audit this PowerShell runbook for reliability risks. Identify each issue, explain the impact, and recommend a safer pattern.

output_examples.input: Review a script that combines Test-Path checks with a logical operator.
output_examples.output: The review flags the condition as risky and recommends wrapping each path check before combining the results.

output_examples.input: Improve a script that reads JSON and writes nested objects.
output_examples.output: The response recommends raw file reads, explicit JSON depth, UTF-8 output, and clearer error handling.

output_examples.input: Create a reusable Windows PowerShell script outline.
output_examples.output: The result describes a strict-mode structure with path setup, main logic, catch handling, final cleanup, and plain ASCII status messages.

best_practices: Wrap cmdlet calls in parentheses before combining them with logical operators.
Use Join-Path and explicit JSON depth for predictable file and data handling.
Check values for null before reading properties, counts, or string lengths.
anti_patterns: Do not use Unicode status symbols in scripts intended for broad Windows compatibility.
Do not assume nested objects serialize correctly without an explicit JSON depth.
Do not return inside try blocks when cleanup or final status handling is required.

faq.question: Does this skill run PowerShell commands?
faq.answer: No. It provides guidance and examples for writing or reviewing Windows PowerShell scripts.

faq.question: Can it help with PowerShell syntax errors?
faq.answer: Yes. It highlights common syntax issues such as missing parentheses and unsafe property access.

faq.question: Is this only for Windows PowerShell?
faq.answer: The guidance targets Windows PowerShell patterns and compatibility concerns.

faq.question: Does it replace script testing?
faq.answer: No. You should still test scripts in a safe environment before production use.

faq.question: Can Claude Code or Codex use this skill?
faq.answer: Yes. The metadata declares support for Claude, Codex, and Claude Code.

faq.question: What problems does it focus on?
faq.answer: It focuses on operator syntax, ASCII output, null checks, paths, arrays, JSON, and error handling.
